channels.name: Solar Surge
channels.description: Joe Ordia, 10+ years solar experience (system design, sales, installation), 800+ completed projects, Class A contractor and electrician's license. The channel's own tagline emphasizes consumer-facing panel/inverter/battery reviews, but it also hosts genuine sales/business training content ('How to Sell Solar', 'How to Start a Solar Business') tied to his separate Solar Surge University training program.
channels.focus: Mixed: consumer solar buying guides + solar sales/business training
channels.verificationMethod: Fetched the channel page directly to confirm the exact ID. Flagged honestly: unlike most channels counted this session, this one's own self-description leans consumer-facing (product reviews) rather than purely business-focused — included because multiple real, confirmed videos on the same channel specifically teach solar sales and starting a solar business, and the host's business-training credentials (Solar Surge University, hundreds of trained reps) are real.

notes: Nigeria-specific solar content is entirely companies marketing installation services to homeowners (SolarKobo, HakunaSolar, Solynta Energy, WiSolar, GVE, Beebeejump) — real, legitimate businesses, but none teaching other installers/technicians how to run a solar business, so none were counted, matching the same standard applied to real estate and PR agencies. This is a genuinely large, fast-growing Nigerian industry given constant power outages — worth a dedicated future search specifically for Nigerian solar TRAINING academies (several exist for technical certification) that might also cover business setup.
